notes: Company overview: European fintech platform offering mortgage and SME lending underwriting; strict EU data residency for PII.
Primary ask: Private deployment inside customer-managed cloud (Azure + GCP hybrid) with control plane connectivity limited to approved Redwood endpoints.
They prefer data plane in customer VNet/VPCs; control plane can be Redwood-managed but must communicate over Private Link/PSC or peering only.
KMS requirement: Azure Key Vault & Google Cloud KMS support; customer insists on HSM-protected keys and automated key rotation logs pushed to their audit stack.
Audit logging: need immutable request metadata, key access events, and model-version change logs sent to Elastic stack and archived for 5 years.

Network topology ask: VNet/VPC per region (eu-west-1 and eu-west-3), private subnets for inference nodes, no public IPs. Option for Transit Gateway/Hub-and-spoke discussed for multi-region connectivity.
Inbound rules: no inbound internet traffic; admin access via corporate jumpbox + Okta-backed SAML SSO; must support Just-In-Time (JIT) access and session recordings.
Outbound rules: egress only to Redwood control-plane endpoints over private endpoints or approved NAT with strict allow-list; telemetry endpoints must be EU-hosted.
Data residency: persisted embeddings and audit artifacts for EU customers must remain in EU; backup snapshot policy must target EU storage only.
Compliance: customer requires proof-of-concept to include SOC2-style evidence and documentation of separation between control and data plane.

POC proposal: 1) whiteboard VNet/VPC diagrams + peering/PSC options, 2) deploy test data plane in eu-west-1, 3) validate KMS wrap/unwrap and key rotation, 4) forward logs to their Elastic instance, 5) run minimal load tests for latency SLOs.
Latency/throughput targets: 99th percentile latency < 180ms for embeddings, sustained throughput 800 reqs/sec for batch reranking use-case.
Fallback/routing: require model routing policy that keeps traffic in-region; fallback to smaller/cheaper quantized model only if same-region capacity unavailable.
Quote from Head of Infra: 'We cannot accept any telemetry or key material leaving EU zones — need architectural proof it won't.'
Action items: Evan to share Azure VNet + GCP VPC reference diagrams; Maya to validate Private Link and Private Service Connect options with infra; Legal to exchange SAML metadata.
Sales note: enterprise procurement cycle ~4-6 months; security sign-off critical path.
